label: platform sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: Cookie banner: after pressing Decline, focus landed on an unnamed div instead of staying logical, so I did not know where I was; banner buttons come before the Skip to content link.
Skip to content link did nothing visible: focus was reset to top of page, and the next Tab went to the hero banner link, so it saved no effort.

findings.page: The Hydrogen Snowboard | Hydrogen Demo Store
findings.problem: Two links in the product area had no name at all (likely image gallery), so I could not tell what they do.

findings.page: The Hydrogen Snowboard | Hydrogen Demo Store
findings.problem: Size and binding options are links with no state announced (no selected/pressed); pressing Enter on 154cm gave no feedback, and the Color group had no options I could focus. I needed about 8 Tabs to reach Add to Cart.

findings.page: The Hydrogen Snowboard | Hydrogen Demo Store
findings.problem: After Add to Cart the cart panel first said the cart was empty and header count stayed 0; only after re-reading did it show the item. No clear announcement that the item was added, and focus was on an unnamed button.

findings.page: The Hydrogen Snowboard | Hydrogen Demo Store
findings.problem: Cart panel opened but the page behind stayed in the Tab order and the first focused cart control (step 21) was an unnamed icon button (probably close); the Remove button is an icon button with just the word Remove, and the quantity minus control was not reachable.

Checkout page showed only the store name at first with no loading message and no focus; I had to re-read to find the form. Page also lists Processing... text and no focus was placed on the first field.
